proposal.hypothesis: Prompting the agent to inspect dataset READMEs and schemas and validate exact output formats before exit reduces failures on data-analysis tasks.
targetFailureModes: output-format or schema misreads on dataset tasks
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt text additionally directs README/schema inspection, output-format re-reads and produced-file verification; no tools, services or section inventory change.
regressionRisks: Dataset-specific guidance may encourage redundant reads on trivial file tasks.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
The solve section text prescribes README/schema inspection and produced-file verification for data tasks.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
